starter.cli:
BOB=$(JIFUNZE_NODE=bob lightning-cli getinfo | jq -r .id)
POINT=$(lncli listchannels | jq -r --arg b "$BOB" '.channels[] | select(.remote_pubkey==$b) | .channel_point' | head -1)
echo "Closing $POINT"
lncli closechannel --chan_point "$POINT"
bitcoin-cli -generate 6

solution.cli:
BOB=$(JIFUNZE_NODE=bob lightning-cli getinfo | jq -r .id)
POINT=$(lncli listchannels | jq -r --arg b "$BOB" '.channels[] | select(.remote_pubkey==$b) | .channel_point' | head -1)
lncli closechannel --chan_point "$POINT"
bitcoin-cli -generate 6
sleep 3
lncli closedchannels | jq '.channels[] | {remote_pubkey, close_type}'
